trading_bot_module.name: Trading Bot
trading_bot_module.description: Allows automated trading through administrator-managed or strategy-based bots. Users can deploy bots to execute trades continuously based on predefined market strategies.

file_manager_module.name: File Manager
file_manager_module.description: Enables secure server-side file management for administrators, including file upload, code editing, archiving, extraction, and directory management within the platform environment.

kyc_module.name: KYC
kyc_module.description: Provides identity verification workflows for user onboarding, document review, and compliance management.
